# Cuprice MCP Server

> Public API tools for integrating Cuprice pricing widgets via Model Context Protocol.

Endpoint: POST https://mcp.cuprice.io/mcp
Docs: https://docs.cuprice.io/mcp
Website: https://cuprice.io

## Tools

- [get-pricing](https://docs.cuprice.io/api-reference/share): Get public pricing data (plans, features, theme) by Share ID
- [get-embed-code](https://docs.cuprice.io/embed/overview): Get embed snippet for HTML, Next.js, or React
- [get-receipt](https://docs.cuprice.io/api-reference/receipt): Get Stripe purchase details from a checkout session
- [get-css-classes](https://docs.cuprice.io/customization/custom-css): Get CSS class names for widget customization
